source.title: Expressions in node parameters resolve to null when referencing a Code node via $('…') with task runners disabled (regression in 1.123.x)

labels.name: status:in-linear
labels.description: Issue or PR is now in Linear

source.body:
### Bug Description

After upgrading a self-hosted instance from **1.121.3 to 1.123.85** (Docker, SQLite, task runners **disabled** — `N8N_RUNNERS_ENABLED` not set), any expression **in a node parameter** that reads the output of a **Code node** through `$('<Code node>')` resolves to `null`. Most nodes raise no error, so executions finish as `success` with wrong data.

Results of the minimal workflow below, run in a clean container (expressions placed in a Set node):

| Expression | Referenced node | 1.123.85, runners disabled | 1.123.85, `N8N_RUNNERS_ENABLED=true` |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$('Code').first().json.value` | Code | `null` ❌ | `from_code` ✅ |
| `$('Code').item.json.value` | Code | `null` ❌ | `from_code` ✅ |
| `$node['Code'].json.value` (legacy) | Code | `from_code` ✅ | `from_code` ✅ |
| `$('Edit Fields').first().json.value_set` | Set | `from_set` ✅ | `from_set` ✅ |
| `$json.value` (direct input from the Code node) | Code | `from_code` ✅ | `from_code` ✅ |

In our production instance we also checked:
- `JSON.stringify($('Code').first())` in a parameter → `null` (runners disabled); the full item with runners enabled.
- `$('Code').first().json.value` **inside another Code node** → correct value in both modes.

Observations:
- Only references to **Code** nodes are affected. References to Webhook, Postgres and Set nodes work.
- The editor's parameter preview shows the correct value. The `null` only appears at execution time; manual, webhook and schedule executions are all affected.
- Enabling task runners (`N8N_RUNNERS_ENABLED=true`, internal mode) fixes it. That is our current workaround.

**Regression evidence (1.121.3):** the same production workflow, with identical node parameters, worked on 1.121.3. An execution on 2026-10-14 created a Google Drive folder with the name and parent folder taken from `$('Configuración').first().json…`. After upgrading to 1.123.85, the first two executions created a folder named `Untitled` in the Drive root.

Real impact we hit in production after the upgrade:
- **Google Drive → Folder → Create**: name and parent folder taken from a Code node → folder created as `Untitled` in the **Drive root**, no error. Uploads with `folderId` from a Code node also went to the root, and those files contained personal data.
- **Google Drive → File → Move**: `folderId` from a Code node → the file stays in the root, no error.
- **Postgres → Execute Query** with `queryReplacement` = `{{ [$("Code").item.json.x] }}` → `Query Parameters must be a string of comma-separated values or an array of values`.
- **Gmail → Send** with `sendTo` = `{{ $('Code').item.json.email }}` → `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'split')`.
- **Odoo** filters and **IF** conditions fed from a Code node → empty values, silently wrong results.

Possibly related: #35559 (expressions silently resolving to `null` because an internal error is swallowed while rendering the expression) and the expression VM isolate mentioned in #41322 and in the 1.123.63 release note ("Preserve Date values passed to the expression isolate"). Our guess is that the output of the legacy in-process Code sandbox cannot be transferred to the expression isolate, and the resulting error becomes `null`. We have not verified this in the source.

### To Reproduce

1. Save the workflow below as `repro.json`.
2. Run it in a clean instance with default settings (task runners disabled):
```bash
   mkdir -p /tmp/n8n-repro && cp repro.json /tmp/n8n-repro/
   docker run --rm -v /tmp/n8n-repro:/home/node/.n8n n8nio/n8n:1.123.85 import:workflow --input=/home/node/.n8n/repro.json
   docker run --rm -v /tmp/n8n-repro:/home/node/.n8n n8nio/n8n:1.123.85 execute --id=repro00000000001 --rawOutput
```
   (Or import it in the editor and click *Execute workflow*.)
3. Look at the output of the `Result` node: `A_code_first` and `B_code_item` are `null`.
4. Repeat with a fresh folder, adding `-e N8N_RUNNERS_ENABLED=true` to the `execute` command: all fields have the expected values.

<details><summary>repro.json</summary>

```json
{ "id": "repro00000000001", "name": "Repro: $() reference to Code node returns null", "active": false,
  "settings": { "executionOrder": "v1" },
  "nodes": [
    { "parameters": {}, "name": "Start", "type": "n8n-nodes-base.manualTrigger", "typeVersion": 1, "position": [0, 0] },
    { "parameters": { "jsCode": "return [{ json: { value: 'from_code' } }];" }, "name": "Code", "type": "n8n-nodes-base.code", "typeVersion": 2, "position": [220, 0] },
    { "parameters": { "assignments": { "assignments": [ { "id": "s1", "name": "value_set", "value": "from_set", "type": "string" } ] },
        "includeOtherFields": true, "options": {} }, "name": "Edit Fields", "type": "n8n-nodes-base.set", "typeVersion": 3.4, "position": [440, 0] },
    { "parameters": { "assignments": { "assignments": [
        { "id": "r1", "name": "A_code_first", "value": "={{ $('Code').first().json.value }}", "type": "string" },
        { "id": "r2", "name": "B_code_item", "value": "={{ $('Code').item.json.value }}", "type": "string" },
        { "id": "r3", "name": "C_code_node_legacy", "value": "={{ $node['Code'].json.value }}", "type": "string" },
        { "id": "r4", "name": "D_set_first", "value": "={{ $('Edit Fields').first().json.value_set }}", "type": "string" },
        { "id": "r5", "name": "E_json", "value": "={{ $json.value }}", "type": "string" } ] }, "options": {} },
      "name": "Result", "type": "n8n-nodes-base.set", "typeVersion": 3.4, "position": [660, 0] }
  ],
  "connections": {
    "Start": { "main": [[{ "node": "Code", "type": "main", "index": 0 }]] },
    "Code": { "main": [[{ "node": "Edit Fields", "type": "main", "index": 0 }]] },
    "Edit Fields": { "main": [[{ "node": "Result", "type": "main", "index": 0 }]] }
  }
}
```
</details>

### Expected behavior

`$('Code').first().json.value` and `$('Code').item.json.value` should return `from_code`, as they did in 1.121.3 and as they do with task runners enabled. If the referenced data cannot be evaluated, n8n should raise an expression error instead of silently returning `null`.

comments.text:
Tested the same repro on 1.121.3 and it works fine there, so this broke somewhere between 1.121.3 and 1.123.85.

```
version    runners   $('Code').first()  $('Code').item  $node['Code']  $('Edit Fields')  $json
1.121.3      off           from_code          from_code        from_code        from_set            from_code
1.123.85   off           null                       null                    from_code        from_set            from_code
1.123.85   on           from_code           from_code       from_code        from_set             from_code
```

One thing if you want to try it on 1.121.3: the import fails with `NOT NULL constraint failed: workflow_entity.versionId` unless you add a `"versionId"` (any UUID) to repro.json. 1.123.85 doesn't need it.
